title: SymADiT: Symmetry-Aware Crystal Generation with Latent Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.10115v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tackling the task of crystal generation, we aim to enhance the previously proposed, symmetry-agnostic, All-atom Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) by introducing SymADiT, a symmetry-aware variant. To do so, we use a representation of crystals based on Wyckoff positions. We follow ADiT and perform generative modelling in latent space, adapted to our symmetry-aware representation. By forcing the output of the generative model to adhere to the symmetry restrictions imposed by the generated crystal's space group and each atom's Wyckoff position, the generated crystals exhibit more realistic symmetry properties. We benchmark our method against both symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic models for crystal generation and show competitive performance, generating stable, symmetric, and physically plausible crystals with only an off-the-shelf Transformer architecture. Our code is available at https://github.com/Karmush21/SymADiT.

translated_title: SymADiT：基于潜在流匹配的对称性感知晶体生成
translated_abstract: 针对晶体生成任务，我们旨在通过引入SymADiT——一个对称性感知的变体，来改进先前提出的、不依赖对称性的全原子扩散Transformer（ADiT）。为此，我们采用了基于Wyckoff位置的晶体表示。我们遵循ADiT的做法，在潜在空间中进行生成建模，并将其适配到我们的对称性感知表示上。通过强制生成模型的输出遵守由所生成晶体的空间群以及每个原子的Wyckoff位置所施加的对称性限制，生成的晶体展现出更真实的对称性特性。我们将我们的方法与对称性感知和不依赖对称性的晶体生成模型进行了基准测试，结果显示出具有竞争力的性能，仅使用现成的Transformer架构就能生成稳定、对称且物理上合理的晶体。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Karmush21/SymADiT 获取。
tldr: SymADiT通过基于Wyckoff位置的对称性感知表示和潜在空间流匹配生成建模，强制输出遵守晶体空间群与Wyckoff位置的对称性约束，从而仅用现成的Transformer架构即可生成稳定、对称且物理合理的晶体。
en_tdlr: SymADiT improves the symmetry-agnostic ADiT by using a Wyckoff-position-based symmetry-aware latent representation with flow matching, enforcing space-group and Wyckoff constraints so that an off-the-shelf Transformer can generate stable, symmetric, and physically plausible crystals.
